verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs say you can build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them downstream, and the site says business teams can segment and activate data through AI chat interfaces. Nothing in the evidence describes a visual, no-SQL builder, and the Profiles layer it cites is defined in YAML. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual audience builder, explicit no-SQL trait/behavior segmentation for marketers, estimated audience size preview before activation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
